arStrings.szText: Nonsense! We are all alive and well, by the blessings of mighty Akarat himself. A cause for celebration!
Brother Ivo, you have failed your fellow Knights, your vows, and the Light. By betraying your order for a false prophet, you have brought shame upon the Knights Penitent.
Your very existence is now a blasphemy. Recant your false faith and repent. Otherwise, you know the fate that awaits you.
Ivo, it isn't too late. Free yourself from this foolishness, this...bloody “Akarat,” and return with me to Kor Valar where we belong.
You would dare speak the name of Akarat with such vitriol on your tongue?
I’d say it’s high time I introduced you to the one, true savior...
